title: Brewfather Coffee Repeatability Gap
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewfather:coffee recipe_name=* tds_pct=* brew_seconds=*
| stats stdev(tds_pct) as tds_stdev, stdev(brew_seconds) as brew_time_stdev, count as brews by recipe_name
| eval tds_stdev=round(tds_stdev,3), brew_time_stdev=round(brew_time_stdev,1)
| sort - tds_stdev - brew_time_stdev
description: Measures how repeatable each saved coffee recipe is across multiple brews.
value: The recipes worth keeping are the ones you can reproduce reliably without fighting the process every morning.
implementation: Log each Brewfather coffee execution with TDS and total brew time, then rank recipes by variability.
visualization: Table of recipes with TDS and brew-time variability.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which coffee recipes come out the same each time and which ones keep wobbling around.
